summary.name: Baidu
summary.one_liner: Baidu (百度) is a Chinese-language web search engine homepage, as shown by the page's title and description.
use_cases: look up web content from china
summary.what_it_does: The page is the Baidu homepage, described in its meta description as a Chinese-language search engine with a web database of over a trillion Chinese pages (超过千亿). The visible text is mostly footer content: the About Baidu, help center and business promotion links, plus a list of Chinese internet operating and filing licenses. It does not describe any search features, AI tools or other capabilities beyond search. The Baidu AI Partner listing is not described on this page.
notable: Claims a web database of over 100 billion (千亿) Chinese pages
Lists Chinese internet content and medical-information licenses in the footer
caveats: Page text is mostly footer and licensing info; no feature details are given
Free use is implied by the homepage only; no pricing is stated on the page
